content: # Palma de Mallorca Airport. | Palma de Mallorca Airport  *Aeroport de Palma de Mallorca*  *Aeropuerto de Palma de Mallorca* | |. | |  |  | | --- | --- | | Passengers | 33,806,427 | | Passenger change 24-25 | Increase 1.5% | | Aircraft movements | 246,486 | | Movements change 24-25 | Increase 6.2% | | Cargo (kilos) | 5,836,421 | | Cargo change 24-25 | Decrease 13.6% | | |. | Passenger change 24-25 | Increase 1.5% |. **Palma de Mallorca Airport** (IATA: **PMI**, ICAO: **LEPA**) — also known as **Son Sant Joan Airport** – is an international airport located eight kilometres (five miles) east of Palma, Mallorca, Spain, adjacent to the village of Can Pastilla. In 2024, the airport handled 33.3 million passengers, making it the third busiest airport in Spain, after Madrid–Barajas and Barcelona–El Prat; and the fourteenth in Europe. The airport is the main base for the Spanish carrier Air Europa and also a focus airport for Eurowings, EasyJet, Jet2.com, Ryanair and Vueling.
